distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) provides the first mainland-China records from Yunnan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently documents the previously known Taiwan occurrence; the 2022 revision remains controlling for current mainland synthesis.

host_note: Cyclobalanopsis morii is retained as literature host evidence. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports the same host for Taiwan; no additional host taxa are inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus blandfordi Gebhardt, 2006.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus blandfordi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone and Liao et al. (2022): Scolytoplatypus blandfordi Gebhardt, 2006, VSN_5397. Beaver & Liu (2010) is retained as earlier Taiwan evidence and does not override the later revision.
